research-watch.description: Finds new papers and new releases of alternative SDKs for one QUMO module, and ranks what QUMO should adopt.

code-review.description: Reviews QUMO code for performance and security on an independent model; reports file:line findings with failure scenarios.

autoresearch.description: Improves one QUMO module step by step in a sandbox branch: hypothesis, baseline, change, measurement, review.

qumo-operator.description: Uses QUMO through MCP: builds algorithms, simulates and compiles circuits, runs QEC experiments, explains error codes.

algorithm-research.description: Explores new quantum algorithms, checks them against QUMO's library and prototypes toy instances.

qec-research.description: Explores new error-correcting codes and decoders and compares them with QUMO's QEC baseline.

compiler-research.description: Explores new circuit optimisation and compilation methods and measures QUMO's current compiler as the baseline.

execution.description: Runs circuits the best available way: validates, sizes, picks simulator or GPU, compiles and emulates targets.

orchestrator.description: Splits a problem between classical, AI and quantum stages and delegates to every research and execution agent.
